novelty_flags.label: prop:matroid-certificate
novelty_flags.one_line: Its min-max rank formula, forest packing, and polynomially checkable certificate are classical graphic-matroid union content; retain it only as a corollary of the new attainable-rank theorem.

soundness_flags.label: symbol:H_ex
soundness_flags.one_line: H_ex is defined as P(U|Z_e,X,S=e), but U is absent from the declared observed-data law P; define it as a completion-dependent H^Q instead.

soundness_flags.label: thm:proxy-rank-ceiling and thm:generic-tree-rank
soundness_flags.one_line: A_P is block diagonal over every x, whereas q and the hypotheses are fixed-stratum objects; the stated global ranks omit the sum over covariate strata or an explicit restricted operator A_{P,x}.

soundness_flags.label: def:exact-cell-projection and thm:exact-cell-projection
soundness_flags.one_line: The projected-set construction uses R_p, which is not declared or defined; only R_0 is available.

soundness_flags.label: ass:outcome-interior
soundness_flags.one_line: Strict positivity of every joint potential-outcome cube cell is much stronger than the justification's marginal nondeterminism claim and is not credibly motivated as realistic for multiarms.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2303.10134, v1 corroborating the cited 2023 Statistics & Probability Letters article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Proposition 2.3 states that beta_o=E[phi_o h] is identified iff phi_o belongs to the orthogonal complement of the null space of T_o.
The paper concerns one source and one target RCT, a missing target treatment arm, adjustment and reweighting proxies, and an asymptotically normal estimator.
For categorical proxies, the paper derives identification under an invertible observed proxy matrix and explicitly relates it to proxy-rank information.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the London Mathematical Society s1-36(1), 445-450, version of record
source_verification_receipts.locator: Article record and theorem subject, pages 445-450
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The cited article is the classical edge-disjoint spanning-tree theorem.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Research of the National Bureau of Standards B 69B(3), 147-153
source_verification_receipts.locator: Pages 147-149, Theorems 1-2 and the graphic-matroid forest discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article treats graphic matroids whose independent sets are forests and gives classical partition/packing min-max characterizations underlying the proposed matroid-union certificate.
The paper gives bootstrap calibrated projection confidence intervals with uniformly asymptotic coverage for projections in moment (in)equality models.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Introduce an explicit stratum-restricted operator A_{P,x} and state the global rank as a sum over x; use H^Q for the completion-dependent posterior and repair R_p to R_0 or define R_p.

Replace full positivity of all 2^(k+1) potential-outcome patterns with a precisely stated feasible two-sided tangent condition, or give a substantive clinical/data-generating justification for the full joint-interior model.

Demote the classical matroid-certificate proposition to a corollary and sharpen the causal contribution into a theorem linking a returned certificate to a concrete proxy-network augmentation decision.
Add a worked nontrivial multistratum example showing the repaired causal lift and the q-tree threshold, with at least two published transport/proximal comparators used for a strict regime comparison.

recommended_next_step: Revise the operator notation and interior-model justification, then retain the signed-cell causal lift and attainable-rank theorem as the field-tier kernel while demoting the standalone classical matroid result.
